title: CERTIFAI: Counterfactual Explanations for Robustness, Transparency, Interpretability, and Fairness of Artificial Intelligence models
reasoning: While the paper discusses the ethical and moral obligations of AI researchers and proposes a method to audit fairness, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/theological systems themselves; it focuses on a technical algorithmic framework for fairness and robustness in standard machine learning models.
